payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the CNN model consistently outperforms other models in various tasks related to offensive content detection, making it the best performing model.

claims.text: The CNN model achieved the highest macro-F1 score of 0.80 in discriminating between offensive and non-offensive posts, outperforming the RNN model.
In the task of identifying insults and threats, the CNN system outperformed the BiLSTM with a macro-F1 score of 0.69.
A CNN-based sentence classifier achieved the best results across all sub-tasks in the experiments conducted.
